name: clam
description: Cam's Claude Code plugins: the lego workflow plus workflow clusters converted from clam-code (PR workflow, session modes, decision logs, team review, worktrees, notifications, and focused guard plugins).

plugins.name: lego
plugins.description: Technology-agnostic lego workflow: contract-first planning, scaffolded stubs, realm-restricted test and implementation agent waves.

plugins.name: decision-log
plugins.description: Record technical decisions: one-shot DL drafting, section-by-section collaborative authoring, and pending-decision rundowns.

plugins.name: tracking
plugins.description: Tracking-document workflow: .local/TODO.md as session state of record, 13-state lifecycle with Stop-hook enforcement, a built-in task-tools deny, absorbed stall-recovery (capture hook + /make-progress skill), and resume-after-/clear via SessionStart injection.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Statusline with context usage, session cost, effort, and tracking State. Wired explicitly via /statusline:setup.

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: Git worktree workflow on top of the git-helpers utilities (newtree, rmtree, copyenv, cloneBareRepo), including a worktree-per-worker pattern for parallel agents.

plugins.name: notifications
plugins.description: Summoning stack: terminal bell, desktop notification, tmux highlight, and ntfy phone push on the transition into summoning states; silent for parked sessions.

plugins.name: landing
plugins.description: The landing seam: /landing:land lands finished work per the repo's committed policy in .claude/clam-profile.jsonc (github-pr or local-merge); /landing:init detects and records the policy; SessionStart injection keeps every session aware of it.

plugins.name: attribution
plugins.description: Suppress Claude Code co-author attribution on commits and PRs. Install changes nothing; /attribution:setup writes the setting at the plugin's installation scope.

plugins.name: settings
plugins.description: Opinionated Claude Code session defaults: agent teams, adaptive thinking, model, effort level, and permission mode. Install changes nothing; /settings:setup writes the settings at the plugin's installation scope.

plugins.name: privacy
plugins.description: Opt out of Claude Code telemetry, error reporting, feedback surveys, and non-essential traffic. Install changes nothing; /privacy:setup writes the settings at the plugin's installation scope.

plugins.name: orchestrator-handover
plugins.description: Orchestrator-to-orchestrator handover: write a handover document, scaffold the recipient worktree, populate its .local/, and hand off to the user.

plugins.name: debugging
plugins.description: Root-cause debugging guidance for orchestrators: reproduction, what-changed archaeology, differential diagnosis, binary-search isolation, log/DB evidence gathering with engineer paste-back, and class-level recurrence prevention.

plugins.name: skill-tracker
plugins.description: Skill invocation telemetry: logs every /skill trigger to ~/.claude/skill-triggers.jsonl and reports usage stats via /skill-tracker:stats.

plugins.name: render-doc
plugins.description: Render a planning or decision markdown file into a self-contained dark-theme HTML view, with an annotation server whose in-page composer writes feedback back into the source markdown.

plugins.name: build
plugins.description: High-level software build lifecycle framework: composites landing, lego, and tracking into a cohesive delivery lifecycle. Provides PR description sync and delivery workflow context.

plugins.name: session-data
plugins.description: Locate the current Claude Code session's conversation data files — transcript JSONL, subagent transcripts, file-history snapshots, session metadata — with sensitivity annotations.

plugins.name: ask-in-text
plugins.description: Kills the AskUserQuestion picker UI: a PreToolUse deny blocks the tool outright, and SessionStart context redirects Claude to ask the engineer in plain text — numbered questions, one decision per number, a recommended default each, bare-go semantics.

plugins.name: management
plugins.description: Guided plugin update flow: /management:update refreshes the clam catalog, diffs installed vs latest versions, applies per-plugin updates on confirmation, and surfaces which setup skills need re-running via setup version stamps.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Injects the Voice communication spec — conclusion-first, working-memory-friendly reply structure — into every session via a SessionStart hook.
